title: Razorfen Downs
body: Razorfen Downs lies deep in the Razorfen at the southern edge of the Barrens, entered through the great maw the quilboar hold to be their boar god's own. It was long the chief city of the quilboar. Now the dead hold it: withered quilboar risen from their own kind guard its bramble halls, skeletons and ghouls crowd the paths further in, and Death's Head necromancers walk among them. Near the entrance fires burn at a great idol, and the deeper one goes the colder the air.

parts.body: Outside the maw a night elf, Myriam Moonsinger, watches an undead diplomat. The Forsaken do not pass on their illness, she reasons, so this one must be of the Scourge.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Razorfen_Downs_(Classic), official description (crafted from the same vines as the Kraul; the traditional capital city of the quilboar; their high priests the Death's Head; the lich Amnennar the Coldbringer has taken control and turned the maze of thorns into a bastion of undead might)

parts.body: A letter on the crone Charlga's body, signed by Ambassador Malcin, offered her the Barrens and the lands beyond in return for freedom to act there. It was carried to the Undercity.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Razorfen_Downs_(Classic), official description (crafted from the same vines as the Kraul; the traditional capital city of the quilboar; their high priests the Death's Head; the lich Amnennar the Coldbringer has taken control and turned the maze of thorns into a bastion of undead might)

parts.body: Malcin, a plagued servant of the Lich King, was slain where he waited outside the Downs, and the Scourge's bid for a foothold on Kalimdor was halted.

title: Amnennar the Coldbringer
body: Amnennar the Coldbringer is a lich, and he rules the Downs. The quilboar there have made a pact with the Scourge, and their boar god's resting place, long held pure, has become a stronghold of the dead. He keeps his seat on a height deep within, a shell of frost about him, and names himself the hand of the Lich King.

parts.body: In the Undercity Andrew Brownell says the lich steers the quilboar's every move by the power of his mind, and holds a direct link of thought to Ner'zhul himself.
sources: creature 7358, single spawn on map 129 at 2403,961 z55 (Glutton 8567 patrols at z24 below); display 7971, Lich model; type 6

parts.body: Not all of the dead here call the quilboar allies. The skeleton Mordresh Fire Eye boasted that the Scourge would enslave them and spread across this barren land.

title: Belnistrasz
body: Belnistrasz was a prisoner of the quilboar, held in their pens deep in the Downs with a Stormwind cook and an ogre. He is not from these parts, he says, and among his kind an oathstone is a bond of agreement. He cares nothing for Horde or Alliance, only for threats to all the races, and the deal the Scourge has made with the quilboar is one.

parts.body: The idol near the entrance is an oven, where the quilboar consume the captives they carry off from the Barrens. Belnistrasz means to shut it down for good by a ritual.
sources: quest 3523 description (thanks for rescuing me; given myself up for dead, or worse, as a meal for these Scourge-infested vermin; the Scourge have brokered some sort of deal with the quilboar, and this nightmare is a result; rather than flee, make a difference; it is probably dangerous) and log text (hand the Oathstone he gave you back to him); AllowableRaces 0, QuestType 2, flags 0

parts.body: When the idol's fires went out, Belnistrasz was gone. In the brazier he left, a great red dragon filled the mind, and his voice said his faith in mortals had been renewed.
